scope: Independent read-only provenance audit of Sylvarant raw generated source images; only this report is written. Alpha derivatives, rendering, visual quality, browser state and runtime catalogues are outside this audit.
method: SHA-256 and file byte length compare each workspace source PNG against its recorded built-in image tool original. Recorded hashes are verified where present; missing hashes are computed only into this report.
activeSelectionRule: All 35 warrior source images; 13 pool emblem finals plus province-sylvarant-v2. province-sylvarant and pool-02-v1 are retained superseded originals.
